entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand tracker. I got it about a week ago and it's useless. I want my money back, and I don't want a hassle.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, is it a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue?
Look, I'm not here to play 20 questions. It doesn't work for me, that's all you need to know. Your website policy says 90 days. It's been seven. Process the return or get me your manager.
Okay, I understand completely. We can definitely skip the troubleshooting. To pull up your order, could I please have your email address?
It's a_miller@example.com. And I'm telling you, if I hear the words 'store credit,' I'm filing a chargeback and leaving reviews on every single website you can think of.

Thank you, I'm pulling that up now... One moment. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 26th. You are absolutely correct, that was just seven days ago, so you are well within the 90-day return window.
So you're actually going to do it? No more games?

Yes, of course. I have just approved your return for a full refund. I am emailing a pre-paid shipping label to you right now. Just attach that to the original packaging and drop it at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay. That's... fine. I'll look for the email then.
The email has been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else at all I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
